notes.title: Patch 1.31.a
notes.content:

Also it's been hilarious seeing all your posts on socials playing the new update!! Keep on dilly dallying!!![/p][h2]
PATCH NOTES[/h2][p][b]
FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Re-enabled Lava rising in The Kiln. If it still doesn't work that's really embarrassing for us. But we put it on the beta branch and you guys didn't say it was broken so it'll be embarrassing for you too!![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]SETTINGS[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a "Jump to Grab Wall" option in General Settings that is on by default. Currently when you're midair you can press Jump to grab the wall in addition to the Climb button. Some players expressed not loving it so we're adding an option to disable it.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now rebind to the Enter, Caps Lock, and Backspace keys.[/p][/*][*][p]The Tab key is now properly bound to Stash Item and can be rebinded (rebound? idk).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]

[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The DILLYDALLY Mini-Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Finally,[/b]

The most highly requested feature since launch is here. [strike]Chess in the Airport.[/strike] CONTROL REBINDING!!  To go alongside this, we added some new features to tide you all over until our next major biome release. [/p][p]Since it's PEAK WEEK on Twitch, we thought we'd focus on some low scope ways to enhance the roleplay experience and kill some time in the airport while you're waiting on your friends to boot up and have 1000 people in chat to entertain.[/p][p]
[b]We also added another badge to go after, so hopefully you guys will be a little less disappointed when its an Alpine day...[/b]
[/p][h2]REBINDABLE CONTROLS[/h2][p][b]Sorry for the delay on this but it's finally here! You can now remap your controls on Keyboard & Mouse or on Gamepads.[/b][i]
[/i][/p][p]It's not a perfect feature as we probably missed some rarer inputs, so let us know if you've got one and we'll try to look into it.
[i]
Keep in mind you can only do this from the Pause Menu at the Airport or on the Island, not at the Main Menu.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]DILLY DALLYING[/h2][p]There are some new exciting ways to waste time in the Airport![/p][h3]BASKETBALL[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/93e652adeaf2fd3962f22c48d20eee68bcd5f806.jpg"][/img][i]This was on our knowyourmeme page...[/i][/p][p]
Basketball is in the Airport. We even made it dribble! Not sure what a real half-court game looks like here, but you can definitely play H-O-R-S-E and Knock-Out. Get creative!
[/p][h3]CHESS[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/c9e994dabdc2d3aaccf25ed992d4237b0b8f5182.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Basketball isn't your thing? Do you work out at the library? There's a big ol' chess board now too. Pieces will automatically lock in place after placing them down so don't worry about a stray basketball ruining your 200 IQ setup. 

Admittedly, this is the laziest implementation of Chess imaginable. There's no chess engine to tell you if you've blundered. There's nothing stopping you from doing illegal moves they're literally just physics objects. It's like real life ok.[/p][h3]
PHOTOBOOTH[/h3][p]Take cute pictures with all your friends! The game will automatically take a screenshot and save it to your Steam Screenshots folder. There's even some "prop" versions of your favorite items that don't work, but you can pose with them![/p][h3]
ASK BING BONG[/h3][p]That's right there's dillydallying past the airport too.  Not sure if you can make that jump? Just ask Bing Bong! He's now equipped with a voice box that will give you a yes-or-no answer when you squeeze him. Another reason to take him to the PEAK. Speaking of Bing Bong...[/p][h3]
WHAT IF BING BONG WAS REAL... OH WAIT WHAT IF [i]SCOUTS[/i] WERE REAL...
[/h3][p]It's almost time to hold Bing Bong in your very own hands! Maybe even a fellow scout if you're still lacking in friends to take to the PEAK. Stay tuned for updates in the next few days, but for now look at the mysterious teaser image for anticipation...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/94af113e6d90bf1501e1c9c8adc70bb842d2d65e.png"][/img][/p][h3]PEAK WEEK ON TWITCH[/h3][p]Ok Content Creators and Clip Farmers - IT'S PEAK WEEK! For the next week on Twitch, Any streamer who uses [url="https://help.twitch.tv/s/article/stream-together?language=en_US"]Stream Together[/url] to play PEAK and any of their viewers who watch between [i]12 AM PT September 23rd and 11:59 PM PT September 30th[/i] will receive an exclusive PEAK Twitch emote. So grab some fellow scouts and start climbing![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/da0fce05afe1b3fbfd699d143ffcfbd240dc1908.gif"][/img][/p][p]Ok we're done glazing lmao - Here's the patch notes:[/p][h3]
PATCH NOTES[/h3][p][b]
OPTIONS[/b][/p][list][*][p]The "Controls" page is now "Rebind Controls" and you can rebind your controls there.[b]
[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Chess to the Airport.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Basketball to the Airport.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Photobooth to the Airport.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new badge.[/p][/*][*][p]Added two new costumes for completing the new badge.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]BALANCE[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Tomb maze is now less likely to be blocked off.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]It's no longer possible for the Capybara oasis to spawn in walls in the MESA.[/p][/*][*][p]It's no longer possible for the Campfire to spawn on a tree at the top of the TROPICS.[/p][/*][*][p]It now takes less stamina to let go and regrab the wall at the same or lower position.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the main menu played SFX when SFX was muted.[/p][/*][*][p]Being passed out from Thorns now will not cause the death timer to decay at a faster rate.[/p][/*][*][p]FIxed an issue where a large piece of wall would sometimes be visible in the Airport mirror.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.27.a
notes.content:
[p]Greetings scouts! Do I have good news for you!

This patch comes with some much-requested features for players with low-end hardware or previously unsupported graphics cards. Namely the Texture Quality setting and the DX11 Graphics API option. If you've experienced low framerate, missing graphics, or crashes, please try these options out!

Additionally, we've added Photosensitive Mode for players averse to flashing lights and dramatic screen effects. This mode has a handful of changes to visuals listed below, but if we missed something that you'd find helpful please let us know!

Finally, the MESA and ALPINE will now alternate every day. When we patch and rotate the maps, you might still see two in a row. Keep in mind that if-and-when we add new replacement biomes, we’ll have to update this with a more sophisticated randomizer.

Happy climbing!
[/p][h2]PATCH NOTES:
[/h2][h3]OPTIONS[/h3][list][*][p]NEW GRAPHICS SETTING: Texture Quality[/p][list][*][p]This is actually huge. You can now lower the texture quality across the game, which is important for players with low VRAM. This can resolve issues with low framerate, missing graphics, and even crashes. Also it doesn’t even look much worse. Check it out![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]NEW GRAPHICS API: DX11[/p][list][*][p]The game can now be launched in DX11 in addition to our DX12 and Vulkan options. For players who have had trouble with our previous two options, give this a try. It might be better, it might be worse. We can’t really confirm which exact configurations of graphics cards this will work better with, but if it can improve it for some of you that’s fantastic![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Render Scale options are now more dramatic, you should see higher performance gains if you play on Medium or Low.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]NEW ACCESSIBILITY SETTING: Photosensitive Mode. [/p][list][*][p]This mode changes the following:[/p][list][*][p]Dynamite, Flare, and Scout Cannon lit fuse effects are less flashy[/p][/*][*][p]Screenshake is lessened.[/p][/*][*][p]Bright lights from the dynamite explosion are disabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fullscreen VFX from taking various sources of damage are less intense and more gradual.[/p][/*][*][p]Fullscreen VFX from the Energy Drink, Lollipop, and Heat Pack are less intense.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]FEATURES[/h3][list][*][p]You can now change your sash in the Passport to any you’ve unlocked via ascents![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]MAPS[/h3][list][*][p]The ALPINE and the MESA will now alternate every other day.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]A secret entrance in the MESA is now open 50% of the time instead of 25%. Feels fair considering the MESA itself is now open 50% of the time as well.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]The Lava Rises again in THE KILN. Admittedly, we didn't fix the issue with it--but since we weren't able to reproduce the issue on our end, we figured it would be helpful to put it back up and get more reports in. If the lava becomes desynced for you, please send us a video or logs![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]BALANCE[/h3][list][*][p]Wait time until the lava rises increased by 1 minute.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]The time for the lava to reach the top once it starts is increased by 3 minutes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]MINOR FIXES[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could pocket unpocketable items while climbing.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Replaced bees sounds in Bug Phobia Mode.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fog walls raised in height again because apparently you could still do Cannon exploit if you did it just right.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.10.b
notes.content:
[h2]HOTFIX 1.10.b[/h2][p][/p][p]Fall damage still had issues after yesterday's patch. It seems like we only resolved half the issue-- so a bigger refactor has been done to hopefully squash it for good. As always, let us know if you're still having issues with it!

For those wondering why its so finicky, it's because it's handled via 'time falling' instead of 'velocity on impact with the ground'. That's because the characters have ragdoll physics, so relying on velocity on impact with the ground is super inconsistent. However, 'time falling' wasn't properly accounting for scenarios where a player was stuck in geometry in midair, but neither falling nor properly in a grounded state. Thanks for your patience while we investigated this!
[/p][h3]PATCH NOTES[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where fall damage was happening where it shouldn't,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where fall damage wasn't happening where it should.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where cooking items multiple times would stack the buffs/debuffs erroneously if eaten before being pocketed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed small translation issues in Polish and French.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: THANK YOU + WHAT'S NEXT FOR PEAK
notes.content:
[p]Hey Scouts o7  Okay so, it's been a wild time since launch. PEAK managed to exceed our expectations of player count and hype by like... a lot. We just hit TWO MILLION COPIES SOLD in 9 days. notes.content: [h2][b]PEAK is out - get ready to climb![/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]The game is available right now on Steam at a 38% discount for a limited time, so that you can get PEAK for a friend too![/b][/h3][p][/p][h1][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527290/PEAK/" style="button"]GET PEAK[/url][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="4bUA3UHajXE;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]LANDFALL AND AGGRO CRAB COLLAB[/b][/h3][p]PEAK is a collab game between [url="https://aggrocrab.com"]Aggro Crab[/url] and [url="https://landfall.se"]Landfall[/url]. In February of this year, parts of our respective teams decided to game-jam together, resulting in PEAK! We couldn’t be happier with this game and how it turned out.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS[/b][/h3][p]PEAK can be played in both single-player and with friends, but for multiplayer, the game is Steam-friends only! Invite up to three of your friends through Steam to climb together and communicate using proximity chat. If you don’t have enough friends to climb with, join our [url="https://discord.gg/peakgame"]Discord[/url] where you can find your very own troop![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/85450be2398dce48b8e9806ab7755c9e40a19085.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]BUGS AND FEEDBACK [/b][/h3][p]No game is ever bug free. If you’re having issues, please write a post in the Steam forums, email us at support@landfall.se or join our [url="https://discord.gg/peakgame"]Discord[/url] and report the bug in the bug reporting channel.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Let’s get climbing,[/h3][h3] [i]- The Landcrab Team[/i][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656916/e696dd666632652791186ac6f22bb964462c7092.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Announcing PEAK!
notes.content: [h2]Announcing PEAK - releasing on the 16th of June![/h2][p][/p][p][b]Ever since we released the teaser back in April of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/aggrocrab"][u]Aggro Crab[/u][/url] and [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/landfallgames"]Landfall[/url][b] collabing on a game, we’ve been so excited to show you all what we’ve been working on![/b][/p][p][/p][p]PEAK is an online co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. As a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its centre. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941859/b07eb5f2d4e6e9d69ff975e2743043242920247a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]WORK TOGETHER[/b][/p][p]Need a hand? You’ll need to rely on your friends to have any hope of scaling the mountain, which changes each time you play. Help each other up ledges, or place ropes and climbing spikes to make the way easier for those who come after.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941859/cfdcbbb486fecad9522d5f4ec9670b43015ff8f3.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]CLIMB[/b][/p][p]The mountain takes no prisoners! Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941859/68b1cc0114f19e184bf82b35ef1ae7a376847122.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]SURVIVE[/b][/p][p]Prepare for the worst! Discover a variety of helpful survival items, from energy drinks to climbing spikes to the mysterious Anti-Rope. You’ve got no hope of making it to the PEAK unless you press every advantage given to you. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941859/3ad3bcf6c902cc1d178befda143b9bf1f3892985.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]EARN BADGES[/b][/p][p]A Well-Seasoned Scout: Show off your survival prowess with dozens of badges to earn and cosmetics to unlock.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32941859/c2cf3b5cb3b171c239aaa61e4b3354a501995cf5.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]CLIMBING IS BETTER WITH YOUR FRIENDS[/b][/p][p]PEAK is a friends-only game! Invite up to three of your friends through Steam to climb together. If you don’t have enough friends to climb with, join our Discord where you can find your very own troop![/p][p][/p][p][b]FEATURES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Climb with up to 4 friends[/p][/*][*][p]4 different climbs[/p][/*][*][p]30 questionable foods[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of different climbing items[/p][/*][*][p]Campfires and marshmallows[/p][/*][*][p]Character customization[/p][/*][*][p]Ghosts[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]The game is releasing on the 16th of June! Make sure to wishlist it so you don’t miss out on PEAK![/b] [/p][p][b]JOIN THE DISCORD: [/b][/p][p][url="http://discord.gg/peakgame"]http://discord.gg/peakgame[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p] [/p]
